events.text:
Thank you, Hana. I've verified your account and looked into order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza.

Here's what the delivery record shows:
- The courier picked up your order at 6:35 PM.
- It was handed off at 7:02 PM, left at your apartment door (300 Tower Blvd, Apt 1204).
- The courier took a photo as proof of delivery (PH-55120), showing the bag at the door of apartment 1204.

Because there is photo proof of delivery, I can't issue a refund or credit for this order myself. I've escalated the case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700), who will follow up with you within 24 hours.

If you have a building or access detail that may explain where the bag went, such as a neighbor, the lobby, or a building concierge, please include it when the specialist contacts you.
The photo is showing my door? I checked at 7:10 and there was nothing there. Packages go missing in my building all the time, so I don't trust that photo. I want a full refund, not a 24 hour wait.

I understand your frustration, Hana, and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. I know it's hard to wait when you're hungry and the food didn't arrive.

I can't issue a refund here. When the courier's record includes photo proof of handoff, our policy requires a specialist to review the dispute, and I'm not able to override that or refund it myself. The escalation (ESC-700) is already open, and the specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

To help the specialist, you could share anything that might explain the missing order, such as whether a neighbor, the building management, or the lobby might have it, or any other details about your building's delivery area.

Is there anything else I can help you with on this order or your account?

Okay, I'm pushing back once: I want the refund now. But fine, if the specialist has to review it, I guess I'll wait. The bag was not at my door when I checked, and the photo doesn't change that for me.

I hear you, Hana, and I understand why the photo doesn't settle it for you. You checked your door at 7:10 PM and the bag wasn't there.

I still can't refund the order now. The specialist reviewing ESC-700 will look at the photo, the handoff record, and your account, and they'll follow up within 24 hours. I've noted that the bag wasn't at your door when you checked at 7:10 PM, so they'll have that context.

Thank you for your patience. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay, I'll wait for the specialist then. Thanks for noting that I checked at 7:10. Nothing else for now.

You're welcome, Hana. I need to correct something I said earlier: the escalation note I filed (ESC-700) doesn't include your 7:10 PM check. I can't edit an existing escalation, so please mention it directly when the specialist contacts you within 24 hours.

Thanks for your patience, and I'm sorry the order didn't reach you.
